description: Asks longbook to draw a report from the ledger over the days and scope named. `title` is its name, `start_date` and `end_date` its first and last day (366 days at most, starting today or earlier), and `accounts`, `members` and `categories` narrow it — left out or empty means all. "No account" names charges billed to no account and "No category" untagged ones; any other name the memory does not hold is refused with the real names, and nothing is ever created. longbook draws the report on its Reports screen the next time the app is open, counting confirmed charges only; nothing waits in Changes. The same name, days and scope asked again redraws the same report.

accounts.description: The accounts the report covers, or "No account" for charges billed to none, each by name as the memory holds it. Left out or empty: all of them.

categories.description: The categories the report covers, or "No category" for untagged charges, each by name as the memory holds it. Left out or empty: all of them.

end_date.description: The last day covered, YYYY-MM-DD: on or after start_date, 366 days at most counting both.

members.description: The people the report covers, each by name as the memory holds it. Left out or empty: all of them.

start_date.description: The first day covered, YYYY-MM-DD. Today or earlier.

title.description: The report's name, as the owner said it — "Goa", "Q3 household". 1 to 80 characters.

name: create_report
title: Create a report
